scope: Register wave 1 (owner decision D1): the dataset ladder and the model ladder in one file, open-register-20261020.json, and the dataset ladder flat in open-register-20261020.csv. B8b freezes this site's rows from entities.ts and the A5 census re-read at the freeze, and merges the external rows B8a built: MOABB record groups, Hugging Face repos and EEGDash mirrors that are this site's datasets become aliases of its rows.

approval.D1: All three: the seven SSVEP follow-ups (new-ssvep-frequencies), Shin2022 with the data-quality page, and IESSEEG with the NeuroLM results (clinical-groups section and the NeuroLM EEGMAT pilot panel)
approval.D2: Status and counts only; the score is held, keeping the one-person rule (Stieger, FALCON H2)
approval.D3: Yes, only facts confirmed by an independent check and backed by a captured original-terms page; factual wording only; a correction route on every row; no prior contact with uploaders
approval.D3_default_kept: HF dataset CSV and card carry no comparison findings unless the owner asks
approval.D4: Rows tied to ICLR 2027 submissions wait until after the 16 December 2026 decisions
approval.D5: The 737 EEGDash mirrors are one family row; the full map stays in the JSON
approval.D11: Hugging Face group = repos the classifier marked in_scope (brain-signal data) from the frozen 28-term + 20-tag snapshot; counts printed for that snapshot with its evidence date
approval.D12: Step 4 'share above chance' shown as 'not computed' until counts exist; own pages for step-2/3 rows deferred
approval.D13: A section on /topics/clinical-groups/ with its own question heading; the Parkinson's h1, short answer and card unchanged

site-register-physionet-eegmmidb-1.0.0: at step 3 by the plan rule, with files opened as a gap at step 2; the census recommended its contiguous step 1

rules.level: A row's level is the furthest step whose anchor item is on file (plan section 2.6, as both register pages state it); items missing at or below the level are its gaps. Three rows traced from their host records whose files were never opened (BNCI2014-004, PhysioNet eegmmidb, BI2013a) stand at step 3 with files opened as a gap at step 2; the census had recommended their contiguous step 1.
rules.share_above_chance: not computed (D12): a gap on every step-4 row where a chance level applies
rules.merges: external rows with merge_into are not rendered; their repo ids, MOABB loaders, DOIs and EEGDash mirror ids become aliases of the site row, and their source group is added to it
rules.terms: a site dataset row states its dataset page's terms (entities.ts), or the census's licence item; a model row states code, weights and data separately, each from the record it names

site_holds.note: The holds this release opens on the eldBETA and ZuCo 2.0 rows are findings with a reason code, each sourced to its hold in releases.ts and data-quality-update.json. A code is declared and attached only once site/src/data/open-register.ts words it in its holdReason table (the page refuses a declared reason it cannot say); until then the row's status and its case link state the hold.

published.json: open-register-20261020.json: both ladders, 487 dataset rows and 40 model rows
published.csv: open-register-20261020.csv: the dataset ladder only, one row per entry, no findings

population.note: D11: the Hugging Face group is the uploads the classifier marked in scope in the frozen snapshot. The classifier audit's re-check (simulated signals, the EMG rule, no evidence beyond names) is applied and its sign-off is pending; the page prints the in-scope count beside its basis.
